text.p: RISCORP Inc said Tuesday that the Nasdaq National Market will delist its common stock as of July 2 because required financial reports have not been filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

RISCORP said its shares are expected to be quoted from now on in the National Daily Quotation sheets, which are commonly referred to as the "pink sheets." The company said it is not seeking a review of the decision.

The company is working with its independent auditors and financial staff to complete its annual report on form 1O-K for 1996. It has revised its target date for this filing to on or before September 24, and continues to expect that results for the fourth quarter and full year of 1996 will be profitable.
RISCORP said its acquisition by Zenthi National Insurance Corp is not affected by the Nasdaq's decision.

"While we regret this action by Nasdaq, our focus between now and the close of our agreement with Zenith is to maximize book value for the benefit of our shareholders," President and Chief Executive Frederick Dawson said in a statement.
RISCORP is a managed care workers' compensation company.
